+The temporal copy is current South942..950 to shifted-cell North960..968.

+def previousCell (b : ZMod (N * 2011)) : ZMod (N * 2011) := b - 2011
+
+def temporalCell (W : ℕ) (b : ZMod (N * 2011)) : ZMod (N * 2011) :=
+  b - ((W / 47 : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))
+
+theorem previousCell_aligned (b : ZMod (N * 2011)) (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) :
+    (previousCell b).val % 2011 = 0 := by
+  have h := (subtraction_residue b 2011).trans hb
+  simpa only [previousCell, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.add_mod,
+    Nat.mod_self, add_zero, Nat.mod_mod] using h
+
+theorem temporalCell_aligned (W : ℕ) (hfield : (W / 47) % 2011 = 0)
+    (b : ZMod (N * 2011)) (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) :
+    (temporalCell W b).val % 2011 = 0 := by
+  have h := (subtraction_residue b (W / 47)).trans hb
+  simpa only [temporalCell, Nat.add_mod, hfield, add_zero, Nat.mod_mod] using h
+
+omit [NeZero (N * 2011)] in
+/-- The temporal displacement is an exact whole-cell stride, including
+zero and values larger than the entire finite cyclic word. -/
+theorem temporalCell_stride (W : ℕ) (hfield : (W / 47) % 2011 = 0)
+    (b : ZMod (N * 2011)) :
+    temporalCell W b = b - ((2011 * ((W / 47) / 2011) : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) := by
+  have h := Nat.mod_add_div (W / 47) 2011
+  rw [hfield, zero_add] at h
+  unfold temporalCell
+  rw [h]
+

+    (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) (j : Fin 8) :
+    (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))).val % 2011 = 987 + j.val := by
+  rw [addition_residue, Nat.add_mod, hb, zero_add, Nat.mod_mod]
+  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
+
+theorem horizontal_unused_residue (b : ZMod (N * 2011))
+    (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) (j : Fin 8) :
+    (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - 1004).val % 2011 = 1994 + j.val := by
+  have h := (subtraction_residue (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) 1004).trans
+    (horizontal_target_residue b hb j)
+  simp only [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
+  have hr := Nat.mod_lt
+    (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - 1004).val (by decide : 0 < 2011)
+  omega

+cell. Only the unsupported marker-bare source is removed. -/
+theorem horizontal_convolution (c : ZMod (N * 2011) → ℕ)
+    (hsupport : ∀ k, k.val % 2011 ∉ lowSupport → c k = 0)
+    (b : ZMod (N * 2011)) (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) (j : Fin 8) :
+    convolution CurrentKernel2011.folded c (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) =

+      c (previousCell b + ((978 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) +
+      reflected c (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) := by

+    rw [horizontal_unused_residue b hb j]
+    simp only [lowSupport_def, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_range,

+    ring

+    (hsupport : ∀ k, k.val % 2011 ∉ lowSupport → c k = 0)
+    (b : ZMod (N * 2011)) (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) (j : Fin 8) :

+    (c carry digits : ZMod (N * 2011) → ℕ)
+    (hc : ∀ k, c k ≤ 1)
+    (hsupport : ∀ k, k.val % 2011 ∉ lowSupport → c k = 0)
+    (hk : ∀ k, carry k ≤ 57)
+    (hrec : ∀ k, carry k =

+    (hlocal : ∀ k, convolution CurrentKernel2011.folded c k + binaryRotation 47 W c k +
+      carry (k - 1) = digits k + radix * carry k)
+    (hm : ∀ k, digits k &&& CurrentHighDigits2011.maskDigits k = 0)

+      c (previousCell b + ((978 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) := by

+  have heven : reflected c (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) % 2 = 0 := by
+    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := reflected_even c (b + ((987 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)))

+/-!
+# Literal South-copy and marker equalities before whole-field alignment

+The nine copy fields960..968 receive the corresponding physical South
+bits942..950, the complete even reflected sum, and the temporal digit.
+The actual support removes both other bare inputs. A physical at-most-one
+selector premise supplies the incoming carry reset. At fractional phase
+zero, the actual mask then equates the two Boolean digits. The temporal
+shift remains W/47 throughout; no multiple-of2011 assumption is made.

+
+open NativeCyclicConvolution NativeCyclicRotation NativeBooleanRotation
+  CurrentMasks2011 CurrentReflectedGeometry2011
+open scoped BigOperators

+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero (N * 2011)]

+theorem south_target_residue (b : ZMod (N * 2011))
+    (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) (j : Fin 9) :
+    (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))).val % 2011 = 960 + j.val := by
+  rw [CurrentClause2011.addition_residue, Nat.add_mod, hb, zero_add, Nat.mod_mod]
+  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

+their absolute cyclic positions lie in a different physical cell. -/
+theorem south_unused_residues (b : ZMod (N * 2011))
+    (hb : b.val % 2011 = 0) (j : Fin 9) :
+    (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - 1004).val % 2011 = 1967 + j.val ∧
+    (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - 2020).val % 2011 = 951 + j.val := by
+  have hr := south_target_residue b hb j
+  have he (e : ℕ) :
+      (((b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - (e : ZMod (N * 2011))).val % 2011)
+        + e) % 2011 = 960 + j.val := by
+    have hh := (CurrentClause2011.subtraction_residue
+      (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) e).trans hr
+    simpa only [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod] using hh
+  constructor
+  · have hh := he 1004
+    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
+    have hl := Nat.mod_lt
+      (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - 1004).val (by decide : 0 < 2011)
+    omega
+  · have hh := he 2020
+    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
+    have hl := Nat.mod_lt
+      (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - 2020).val (by decide : 0 < 2011)
+    omega

+/-- The complete reflected sum is retained, including all coefficient
+collisions; only the two unsupported bare inputs disappear. -/

+        reflected c (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011))) := by

+    rw [h1004]

+    omega
+  have hz2020 : c (b + ((960 + j.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N * 2011)) - 2020) = 0 := by

+    rw [h2020]
+    simp only [lowSupport_def, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_range,
+      Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_singleton]
+    omega

+/-- Fractional phase zero identifies the actual two Boolean bits. The

+    (hc : ∀ k, c k ≤ 1)
+    (hsupport : ∀ k, k.val % 2011 ∉ lowSupport → c k = 0)

+/-!

+
+The tile at each cyclic coordinate is selected in the original Boolean
+word at the canonical inverse cell coordinate. The temporal stride is
+the exact rank-derived quotient, without reducing it or assuming it is
+coprime to the cyclic length. Only Start at the origin is identified.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentMarkedWindow2011
+
+open CurrentPolynomialWindow2011 CurrentOccupation2011 CurrentCellLabels2011
+  CurrentWholeField2011 CurrentTileColors2011 CurrentAdjacency2011
+  CurrentCellTranslation2011 CurrentCellCycle2011 CurrentCellCoordinate2011
+  WangTiles942 WangTiles942Periodic
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- The unchanged temporal bit displacement from the original rank. -/
+def bitShift (v : Fin 14 → ℤ) (N : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  (Carrier65.core CurrentWindowCarry2011.ports v).rank.toNat - 47*(N*2011)
+
+/-- The actual natural whole-cell stride, with no reduction moduloN. -/

+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero (N * 2011)]
+
+local instance (priority := 10) cellCountNeZero : NeZero N :=
+  ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt CurrentCellCycle2011.cellCount_pos⟩
+
+/-- Choice is over the existing selected tile in each original physical cell. -/
+noncomputable def assignment (c : ZMod (N * 2011) → ℕ)
+    (hocc : ∀ b : Cell N, Occupied c b) : ZMod N → Fin 942 :=
+  fun j => Classical.choose (hocc (coordinate.symm j))

+theorem assignment_selected (c : ZMod (N * 2011) → ℕ)
+    (hocc : ∀ b : Cell N, Occupied c b) (j : ZMod N) :

+  Classical.choose_spec (hocc (coordinate.symm j))

+    ((coordinate.symm (j-1) : Cell N) : ZMod (N * 2011)) =

+  have he : (coordinate.symm (j-1) : Cell N) = previous (coordinate.symm j) := by
+    apply coordinate.injective
+    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, coordinate_previous, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
+  rw [he, coe_previous]
+  rfl

+aligned shifts including those larger than the entire cyclic word. -/
+theorem temporal_coordinate_base (W : ℕ) (hfield : (W/47)%2011=0) (j : ZMod N) :

+  rw [coordinate_symm_subtractFullCell (W/47) hfield]
+  rfl

+    have hd := Nat.mod_add_div (bitShift v N / 47) 2011
+    unfold stride
+    omega

+/-- Split a binary word into a low prefix and its shifted remaining word. -/
+theorem binaryWord_append (f : ℕ → ℕ) (k n : ℕ) :
+    binaryWord f (k+n) = binaryWord f k + 2^k * binaryWord (fun j => f (k+j)) n := by
+  unfold binaryWord
+  rw [Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.mul_sum]
+  congr 1
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro j _
+  rw [pow_add]
+  ring
+
+/-- Prepending k entries retains precisely the low n entries of the
+shifted word. Only that retained suffix needs the Boolean bound. -/
+theorem binaryWord_prefix (f : ℕ → ℕ) (k n : ℕ)
+    (hf : ∀ j, j < n → f (k+j) ≤ 1) :
+    binaryWord f (k+n) =
+      (2^k * binaryWord (fun j => f (k+j)) (k+n)) % 2^(k+n) + binaryWord f k := by
+  let g := fun j => f (k+j)
+  have hg : binaryWord g n < 2^n := binaryWord_lt g n hf
+  have hl : 2^k * binaryWord g n < 2^(k+n) := by
+    rw [pow_add]
+    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hg (by positivity)
+  have he : binaryWord g (k+n) =
+      binaryWord g n + 2^n * binaryWord (fun j => g (n+j)) k := by
+    simpa only [Nat.add_comm n k] using binaryWord_append g n k
+  have hm : (2^k * binaryWord g (k+n)) % 2^(k+n) = 2^k * binaryWord g n := by
+    rw [he, Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
+      Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hl]
+  change binaryWord f (k+n) = (2^k * binaryWord g (k+n)) % 2^(k+n) + binaryWord f k
+  rw [hm, binaryWord_append]
+  exact Nat.add_comm _ _

+  simp [binaryWord]

+private theorem binaryWord_two (f : ℕ → ℕ) : binaryWord f 2 = f 0 + 2*f 1 := by
+  simp [binaryWord, Finset.sum_range_succ]

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Language
+
+/-!
+# Exact local boundary-color classification for the actual Wang table
+
+Only the literal finite `Allowed` language is used. Transition input heads
+are at most 431; receiving output heads, including halt target 215, are at
+most 433. Thus the boundary colors 434 through 438 have exactly the cases
+listed below. No strip, run, halting, or tiling hypothesis is present.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Boundary
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- The source states are 0 through 214, so transition heads stop at 431. -/
+theorem transition_north_bound (j : Fin 430) : (transitionRow j).2.north ≤ 431 := by
+  change 2 * (j.val / 2) + j.val % 2 + 2 ≤ 431
+  have hj := j.isLt
+  omega
+
+/-- A receiving row may target the halt state 215, giving head 432 or 433. -/
+theorem receive_south_bound {d : Bool} {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ targets d) (b : Fin 2) :
+    headColor q b.val ≤ 433 := by
+  have hq' := target_bounds d q (List.mem_toFinset.mp hq)
+  have hb := b.isLt
+  unfold headColor
+  omega
+
+theorem plain_or_halt_bound (a b : Fin 2) : 432*a.val+b.val ≤ 433 := by
+  have ha := a.isLt
+  have hb := b.isLt
+  omega
+
+/-- Complete possibilities above the nonboundary north-color range. -/
+theorem high_north_cases {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (hn : 434 ≤ t.north) :
+    t = start ∨ t = ⟨2,434,2,0⟩ ∨ t = ⟨3,436,4,4⟩ ∨ t = ⟨4,436,4,0⟩ ∨
+    (∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩) ∨
+    (∃ a b : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩) := by
+  cases ht with
+  | start => exact Or.inl rfl
+  | transition j => have h := transition_north_bound j; omega
+  | pass a b => have h := plain_or_halt_bound a b; simp only at *; omega
+  | receive d q hq b => have h := b.isLt; simp only at hn; omega
+  | finish a b => have h := plain_or_halt_bound a b; simp only at hn; omega
+  | initLeft => exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
+  | initHead => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
+  | initRight => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
+  | reset p hp => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩))))
+  | seam a b => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a,b,rfl⟩))))
+
+/-- Complete possibilities above the nonboundary south-color range. -/
+theorem high_south_cases {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (hs : 434 ≤ t.south) :
+    (∃ a b : Fin 2, t = ⟨0,432*a.val+b.val,0,438⟩) ∨
+    (∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩) ∨
+    (∃ a b : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩) := by
+  cases ht with
+  | start => simp only [start] at hs; omega
+  | transition j =>
+      have h := Bool.toNat_le (action j).1
+      dsimp only [transitionRow] at hs
+      omega
+  | pass a b => have h := plain_or_halt_bound a b; simp only at *; omega
+  | receive d q hq b => have h := receive_south_bound hq b; simp only at hs; omega
+  | finish a b => exact Or.inl ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+  | initLeft => simp only at hs; omega
+  | initHead => simp only at hs; omega
+  | initRight => simp only at hs; omega
+  | reset p hp => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩)
+  | seam a b => exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a,b,rfl⟩)
+
+theorem north_435_iff_start {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) : t.north = 435 ↔ t = start := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hn
+    rcases high_north_cases ht (by omega) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · rfl
+    all_goals norm_num at hn
+  · rintro rfl
+    rfl
+
+theorem north_434_iff_initLeft {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.north = 434 ↔ t = ⟨2,434,2,0⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hn
+    rcases high_north_cases ht (by omega) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num [start] at hn
+    · rfl
+    all_goals norm_num at hn
+  · rintro rfl
+    rfl
+
+/-- The head initializer has south color 4, not the old state-93 color 188. -/
+theorem north_436_iff_initializers {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.north = 436 ↔ t = ⟨3,436,4,4⟩ ∨ t = ⟨4,436,4,0⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hn
+    rcases high_north_cases ht (by omega) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num [start] at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · exact Or.inl rfl
+    · exact Or.inr rfl
+    all_goals norm_num at hn
+  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> rfl
+
+theorem north_438_iff_reset {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.north = 438 ↔ ∃ p ∈ [434,435,436], t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hn
+    rcases high_north_cases ht (by omega) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num [start] at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · exact ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num at hn
+  · rintro ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
+    rfl
+
+theorem north_437_iff_seam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.north = 437 ↔ ∃ a b : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hn
+    rcases high_north_cases ht (by omega) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num [start] at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · norm_num at hn
+    · exact ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+  · rintro ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    rfl
+
+theorem south_438_iff_finish {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.south = 438 ↔ ∃ a b : Fin 2, t = ⟨0,432*a.val+b.val,0,438⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hs
+    rcases high_south_cases ht (by omega) with
+      ⟨a,b,rfl⟩ | ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · exact ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hp
+      simp only at hs
+      omega
+    · norm_num at hs
+  · rintro ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    rfl
+
+theorem south_437_iff_seam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.south = 437 ↔ ∃ a b : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hs
+    rcases high_south_cases ht (by omega) with
+      ⟨a,b,rfl⟩ | ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num at hs
+    · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hp
+      simp only at hs
+      omega
+    · exact ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+  · rintro ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    rfl
+
+/-- A seam color on either vertical edge forces a full seam tile. -/
+theorem north_437_iff_south_437 {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.north = 437 ↔ t.south = 437 :=
+  (north_437_iff_seam ht).trans (south_437_iff_seam ht).symm
+
+/-- Each of the three initialization colors, when on a south edge,
+determines its exact matching reset tile. -/
+theorem south_reset_iff {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ [434,435,436]) :
+    t.south = p ↔ t = ⟨1,438,1,p⟩ := by
+  have hb : 434 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 436 := by
+    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hp
+    omega
+  constructor
+  · intro hs
+    rcases high_south_cases ht (by omega) with
+      ⟨a,b,rfl⟩ | ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · simp only at hs
+      omega
+    · simp only at hs
+      subst q
+      rfl
+    · simp only at hs
+      omega
+  · rintro rfl
+    rfl
+
+/-- All nine finite seam combinations are actually present in the indexed table. -/
+theorem seam_tile_exists (a b : Fin 3) :
+    ∃ i : Fin 942, tile i = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩ :=
+  (allowed_iff_tile _).mp (Allowed.seam a b)
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Boundary

+/-!
+# Exact horizontal initialization colors in the actual finite tile language
+
+Every valid direction-specific rail has color at least6. Thus colors2,3,4

+explicit seam family. These are local classifications, with no row, strip,
+periodicity, computation, or tiling premise.

+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942InitialHorizontal

+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000

+    t = start ∨ t = ⟨2,434,2,0⟩ ∨ t = ⟨3,436,4,4⟩ ∨ t = ⟨4,436,4,0⟩ ∨
+      ∃ a b : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩ := by
+  cases ht with
+  | start => exact Or.inl rfl
+  | transition j =>
+      have hr := (valid_rail_range (action_target_mem j)).1
+      dsimp only [transitionRow] at hs
+      cases hd : (action j).2.1 <;>
+        simp only [hd, Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.sub_zero,
+          Nat.sub_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_mul] at * <;> omega
+  | pass a b => simp only at hs; omega
+  | receive d q hq b =>
+      have hr := (valid_rail_range hq).1
+      cases d <;> simp only [Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.sub_zero,
+        Nat.sub_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_mul] at hs hr <;> omega
+  | finish a b => simp only at hs; omega
+  | initLeft => exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
+  | initHead => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
+  | initRight => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
+  | reset p hp => simp only at hs; omega
+  | seam a b => exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a,b,rfl⟩)))
+
+/-- East2 either continues the left initializer or enters a seam with b=2. -/
+theorem east_2_iff_initLeft_or_seam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.east = 2 ↔ t = ⟨2,434,2,0⟩ ∨ ∃ a : Fin 3, t = ⟨a.val^2,437,2,437⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro he
+    rcases small_horizontal_cases ht (Or.inr (by omega)) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num [start] at he
+    · exact Or.inl rfl
+    · norm_num at he
+    · norm_num at he
+    · exact Or.inr ⟨a, by simp only [show b.val = 2 from he]⟩
+  · rintro (rfl | ⟨a,rfl⟩) <;> rfl

+    rcases small_horizontal_cases ht (Or.inl (by omega)) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · norm_num [start] at hw
+    · norm_num at hw
+    · rfl
+    · norm_num at hw
+    · have ha := a.isLt

+    rfl

+    t.west = 4 ↔ t = ⟨4,436,4,0⟩ ∨ ∃ b : Fin 3, t = ⟨4,437,b.val,437⟩ := by

+  · intro hw
+    rcases small_horizontal_cases ht (Or.inl (by omega)) with

+    · norm_num [start] at hw
+    · norm_num at hw
+    · norm_num at hw
+    · exact Or.inl rfl
+    · exact Or.inr ⟨b, by simp only [show a.val^2 = 4 from hw]⟩
+  · rintro (rfl | ⟨b,rfl⟩) <;> rfl
+

+theorem east_3_iff_start {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) : t.east = 3 ↔ t = start := by
+  constructor
+  · intro he
+    rcases small_horizontal_cases ht (Or.inr (by omega)) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · rfl
+    · norm_num at he
+    · norm_num at he
+    · norm_num at he
+    · have hb := b.isLt
+      simp only at he
+      omega
+  · rintro rfl
+    rfl
+
+/-- West2 cannot be a seam square; it is exactly Start or initLeft. -/
+theorem west_2_iff_start_or_initLeft {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.west = 2 ↔ t = start ∨ t = ⟨2,434,2,0⟩ := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hw
+    rcases small_horizontal_cases ht (Or.inl (by omega)) with
+      rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
+    · exact Or.inl rfl
+    · exact Or.inr rfl
+    · norm_num at hw
+    · norm_num at hw
+    · have ha := a.isLt
+      simp only at hw
+      interval_cases a.val <;> norm_num at hw
+  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> rfl
+
+/-- The seam exception must be excluded explicitly to force initLeft. -/
+theorem east_2_nonseam {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) (he : t.east = 2)

+  · exact hw

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Core
+
+/-!
+# The finite language of the actual 942 Wang tiles
+
+This module classifies the literal table into its printed families. Rail
+injectivity is restricted to actual direction-specific targets, including
+halting target 215. It does not assert a tiling or machine-run equivalence.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Language
+
+open WangTiles942
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- Every actual action lands in the target set for its own direction. -/
+theorem action_target_mem (j : Fin 430) : (action j).2.2 ∈ targets (action j).2.1 := by
+  rw [targets_eq_cache]
+  apply List.mem_toFinset.mpr
+  apply List.mem_map.mpr
+  refine ⟨action j, ?_, rfl⟩
+  apply List.mem_filter.mpr
+  exact ⟨List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩, by simp⟩
+
+theorem decoded_action_target_mem (j : Fin 430) :
+    (DecimalMachine215.action j.val).2.2 ∈
+      targets (DecimalMachine215.action j.val).2.1 := by
+  simpa only [← action_eq_decoder j] using action_target_mem j
+
+/-- The target sets have neither missing targets nor extra unattested targets. -/
+theorem mem_targets_iff (d : Bool) (q : ℕ) : q ∈ targets d ↔
+    ∃ j : Fin 430, (action j).2.1 = d ∧ (action j).2.2 = q := by
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    rw [targets_eq_cache] at h
+    obtain ⟨a, ha, hq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp h)
+    obtain ⟨hma, hda⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp ha
+    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hma
+    exact ⟨j, by simpa using hda, hq⟩
+  · rintro ⟨j, hdir, htarget⟩
+    simpa only [hdir, htarget] using action_target_mem j
+
+theorem mem_targets_iff_decoded (d : Bool) (q : ℕ) : q ∈ targets d ↔
+    ∃ j : Fin 430, (DecimalMachine215.action j.val).2.1 = d ∧
+      (DecimalMachine215.action j.val).2.2 = q := by
+  simpa only [action_eq_decoder] using mem_targets_iff d q
+
+/-- The rank of a member is strictly less than the number of targets. -/
+theorem target_prefix_card_lt {d : Bool} {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ targets d) :
+    (targets d ∩ Finset.range q).card < (targets d).card := by
+  apply Finset.card_lt_card
+  apply Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
+  refine ⟨Finset.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
+  intro he
+  have h : q ∈ targets d ∩ Finset.range q := he.symm ▸ hq
+  have := Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp h).2
+  omega
+
+/-- A target strictly below another number makes the corresponding ranks strict. -/
+theorem rail_strict_mono {d : Bool} {p q : ℕ}
+    (hp : p ∈ targets d) (hpq : p < q) : rail d p < rail d q := by
+  have hc : (targets d ∩ Finset.range p).card < (targets d ∩ Finset.range q).card := by
+    apply Finset.card_lt_card
+    apply Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
+    constructor
+    · intro a ha
+      obtain ⟨hat, hap⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp ha
+      exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hat, Finset.mem_range.mpr
+        (lt_trans (Finset.mem_range.mp hap) hpq)⟩
+    · intro he
+      have hm : p ∈ targets d ∩ Finset.range q :=
+        Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hp, Finset.mem_range.mpr hpq⟩
+      have hm' := he.symm ▸ hm
+      have := Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_inter.mp hm').2
+      omega
+  rw [rail_eq_formula, rail_eq_formula]
+  unfold railFormula
+  omega
+
+/-- No injectivity is claimed away from the actual direction target set. -/
+theorem rail_injective_on (d : Bool) : Set.InjOn (rail d) (↑(targets d) : Set ℕ) := by
+  intro p hp q hq he
+  rcases lt_trichotomy p q with hl | rfl | hl
+  · have := rail_strict_mono hp hl
+    omega
+  · rfl
+  · have := rail_strict_mono hq hl
+    omega
+
+theorem right_rail_range {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ targets true) :
+    6 ≤ rail true q ∧ rail true q < 205 := by
+  have hc := target_prefix_card_lt hq
+  rw [target_counts.2] at hc
+  rw [rail_eq_formula]
+  simp only [railFormula, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.mul_one]
+  omega
+
+theorem left_rail_range {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ targets false) :
+    205 ≤ rail false q ∧ rail false q < 250 := by
+  have hc := target_prefix_card_lt hq
+  rw [target_counts.1] at hc
+  rw [rail_eq_formula]
+  simp only [railFormula, Bool.toNat_false, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
+  omega
+
+theorem directional_rails_disjoint {p q : ℕ}
+    (hp : p ∈ targets false) (hq : q ∈ targets true) :
+    rail false p ≠ rail true q := by
+  obtain ⟨hl, _⟩ := left_rail_range hp
+  obtain ⟨_, hr⟩ := right_rail_range hq
+  omega
+
+theorem valid_rail_range {d : Bool} {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ targets d) :
+    6 ≤ rail d q ∧ rail d q < 250 := by
+  cases d
+  · obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := left_rail_range hq
+    omega
+  · obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := right_rail_range hq
+    omega
+
+/-- The ten printed families. The transition row is already proved equal to
+its exact decimal-decoded action in `transitionRow_eq_decoded`. -/
+inductive Allowed : Tile → Prop
+  | start : Allowed start
+  | transition (j : Fin 430) : Allowed (transitionRow j).2
+  | pass (a b : Fin 2) : Allowed ⟨0, 432*a.val+b.val, 0, 432*a.val+b.val⟩
+  | receive (d : Bool) (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ targets d) (b : Fin 2) :
+      Allowed ⟨d.toNat*rail d q, b.val, (1-d.toNat)*rail d q, headColor q b.val⟩
+  | finish (a b : Fin 2) : Allowed ⟨0, 432*a.val+b.val, 0, 438⟩
+  | initLeft : Allowed ⟨2, 434, 2, 0⟩
+  | initHead : Allowed ⟨3, 436, 4, 4⟩
+  | initRight : Allowed ⟨4, 436, 4, 0⟩
+  | reset (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ [434,435,436]) : Allowed ⟨1,438,1,p⟩
+  | seam (a b : Fin 3) : Allowed ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩
+
+private theorem copy_allowed {a : ℕ} (ha : a < 2) {row : ℕ × Tile}
+    (hr : row ∈ copyRows a) : Allowed row.2 := by
+  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
+  exact Allowed.pass ⟨a,ha⟩ ⟨b,List.mem_range.mp hb⟩
+
+private theorem signal_allowed {d : Bool} {row : ℕ × Tile}
+    (hr : row ∈ signalRows d) : Allowed row.2 := by
+  obtain ⟨q, hq, hr⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hr
+  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
+  exact Allowed.receive d q (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hq) ⟨b,List.mem_range.mp hb⟩
+
+private theorem tail_allowed {row : ℕ × Tile} (hr : row ∈ tailRows) : Allowed row.2 := by
+  simp only [tailRows, List.mem_append] at hr
+  rcases hr with ((h | h) | h) | h
+  · obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
+    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
+    exact Allowed.finish ⟨a,List.mem_range.mp ha⟩ ⟨b,List.mem_range.mp hb⟩
+  · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
+    rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl
+    · exact Allowed.initLeft
+    · exact Allowed.initHead
+    · exact Allowed.initRight
+  · obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
+    exact Allowed.reset p hp
+  · obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
+    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
+    exact Allowed.seam ⟨a,List.mem_range.mp ha⟩ ⟨b,List.mem_range.mp hb⟩
+
+theorem row_allowed {row : ℕ × Tile} (hr : row ∈ indexedRows) : Allowed row.2 := by
+  simp only [indexedRows, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton, List.mem_ofFn] at hr
+  rcases hr with (((rfl | ⟨j,rfl⟩) | (h | h)) | (h | h)) | h
+  · exact Allowed.start
+  · exact Allowed.transition j
+  · exact copy_allowed (by decide) h
+  · exact copy_allowed (by decide) h
+  · exact signal_allowed h
+  · exact signal_allowed h
+  · exact tail_allowed h
+
+private theorem copy_row_mem (a b : Fin 2) :
+    (433-2*a.val+b.val, (⟨0,432*a.val+b.val,0,432*a.val+b.val⟩ : Tile)) ∈
+      copyRows 0 ++ copyRows 1 := by
+  have hm : (433-2*a.val+b.val, (⟨0,432*a.val+b.val,0,432*a.val+b.val⟩ : Tile)) ∈
+      copyRows a.val := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨b.val,List.mem_range.mpr b.isLt,rfl⟩
+  have ha := a.isLt
+  have hv : a.val = 0 ∨ a.val = 1 := by omega
+  rcases hv with hv | hv
+  · apply List.mem_append_left
+    simpa only [hv] using hm
+  · apply List.mem_append_right
+    simpa only [hv] using hm
+
+private theorem signal_row_mem (d : Bool) (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ targets d) (b : Fin 2) :
+    (423+2*rail d q+b.val,
+      (⟨d.toNat*rail d q,b.val,(1-d.toNat)*rail d q,headColor q b.val⟩ : Tile)) ∈
+      signalRows false ++ signalRows true := by
+  have hm : (423+2*rail d q+b.val,
+      (⟨d.toNat*rail d q,b.val,(1-d.toNat)*rail d q,headColor q b.val⟩ : Tile)) ∈
+      signalRows d := List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨q,List.mem_toFinset.mp hq,
+        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨b.val,List.mem_range.mpr b.isLt,rfl⟩⟩
+  cases d
+  · exact List.mem_append_left _ hm
+  · exact List.mem_append_right _ hm
+
+theorem allowed_row {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) : ∃ row ∈ indexedRows, row.2 = t := by
+  cases ht with
+  | start => exact ⟨(0,start), by simp only [indexedRows, List.mem_append,
+      List.mem_singleton, true_or], rfl⟩
+  | transition j =>
+      refine ⟨transitionRow j, ?_, rfl⟩
+      simp only [indexedRows, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton, List.mem_ofFn]
+      exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨j,rfl⟩)))
+  | pass a b =>
+      refine ⟨(433-2*a.val+b.val, _), ?_, rfl⟩
+      apply List.mem_append_left
+      apply List.mem_append_left
+      apply List.mem_append_right
+      exact copy_row_mem a b
+  | receive d q hq b =>
+      refine ⟨(423+2*rail d q+b.val, _), ?_, rfl⟩
+      apply List.mem_append_left
+      apply List.mem_append_right
+      exact signal_row_mem d q hq b
+  | finish a b =>
+      refine ⟨(923+2*a.val+b.val,_), List.mem_append_right _ ?_, rfl⟩
+      apply List.mem_append_left
+      apply List.mem_append_left
+      apply List.mem_append_left
+      exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨a.val,List.mem_range.mpr a.isLt,
+        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨b.val,List.mem_range.mpr b.isLt,rfl⟩⟩
+  | initLeft => exact ⟨(927,_), List.mem_append_right _ (by simp [tailRows]), rfl⟩
+  | initHead => exact ⟨(928,_), List.mem_append_right _ (by simp [tailRows]), rfl⟩
+  | initRight => exact ⟨(929,_), List.mem_append_right _ (by simp [tailRows]), rfl⟩
+  | reset p hp =>
+      refine ⟨(496+p,_), List.mem_append_right _ ?_, rfl⟩
+      apply List.mem_append_left
+      apply List.mem_append_right
+      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
+  | seam a b =>
+      refine ⟨(933+3*a.val+b.val,_), List.mem_append_right _ ?_, rfl⟩
+      apply List.mem_append_right
+      exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨a.val,List.mem_range.mpr a.isLt,
+        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨b.val,List.mem_range.mpr b.isLt,rfl⟩⟩
+
+/-- Exact membership, in both directions, for the actual indexed table. -/
+theorem allowed_iff_tile (t : Tile) : Allowed t ↔ ∃ i : Fin 942, tile i = t := by
+  constructor
+  · intro ht
+    obtain ⟨row, hr, he⟩ := allowed_row ht
+    have hm := ordered_rows_perm.mem_iff.mpr hr
+    obtain ⟨i, hi, hir⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hm
+    exact ⟨⟨i, by simpa only [ordered_count] using hi⟩, by
+      dsimp only [tile]
+      rw [hir, he]⟩
+  · rintro ⟨i,rfl⟩
+    exact row_allowed (ordered_rows_perm.mem_iff.mp (List.getElem_mem _))
+
+theorem tile_allowed (i : Fin 942) : Allowed (tile i) :=
+  (allowed_iff_tile _).mpr ⟨i,rfl⟩
+
+/-- Valid rails are at most 249; every other horizontal color is at most 4. -/
+theorem allowed_horizontal_bound {t : Tile} (ht : Allowed t) :
+    t.west < 250 ∧ t.east < 250 := by
+  cases ht with
+  | start => decide
+  | transition j =>
+      have hr := (valid_rail_range (action_target_mem j)).2
+      dsimp only [transitionRow]
+      cases hd : (action j).2.1 <;>
+        simp only [hd, Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self,
+          Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_mul] at * <;> omega
+  | pass a b => simp
+  | receive d q hq b =>
+      have hr := (valid_rail_range hq).2
+      cases d <;> simp only [Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, Nat.sub_zero,
+        Nat.sub_self, Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_mul] <;> omega
+  | finish a b => simp
+  | initLeft => decide
+  | initHead => decide
+  | initRight => decide
+  | reset p hp => simp
+  | seam a b =>
+      have ha := a.isLt
+      have hb := b.isLt
+      dsimp only
+      constructor
+      · interval_cases a.val <;> decide
+      · omega
+
+theorem tile_horizontal_bound (i : Fin 942) :
+    (tile i).west < 250 ∧ (tile i).east < 250 :=
+  allowed_horizontal_bound (tile_allowed i)
+
+/-- Both complemented horizontal labels are strictly positive in every tile. -/
+theorem complemented_horizontal_positive (i : Fin 942) :
+    0 < 255 - (tile i).west ∧ 0 < 255 - (tile i).east := by
+  obtain ⟨hw,he⟩ := tile_horizontal_bound i
+  omega
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Language

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Language

+/-! Checks of the actual finite language, including a counterexample to
+unrestricted rail injectivity. No tiling, run, or occupancy premise occurs. -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942LanguageChecks
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+-- The real halt is retained; it occurs at decoder action 125.
+example : (action (125 : Fin 430)).2.1 = true ∧
+    (action (125 : Fin 430)).2.2 = 215 := by decide +kernel
+
+example : (DecimalMachine215.action 125).2.2 = 215 := by
+  have he := congrArg (fun a : Action => a.2.2) (action_eq_decoder (125 : Fin 430))
+  exact he.symm.trans (by decide +kernel)
+
+example : 215 ∈ targets true ∧ 215 ∉ targets false := by decide +kernel
+
+example : rail true 215 = 204 ∧ rail false 209 = 249 := by decide +kernel
+
+-- Off the target set, equal rails need not imply equal states.
+example : 0 ∉ targets false ∧ 4 ∈ targets false ∧
+    rail false 0 = rail false 4 ∧ (0 : ℕ) ≠ 4 := by decide +kernel
+
+-- Both reconstruction directions specialize to the actual finite table.
+example : Allowed (tile 1) := tile_allowed 1
+
+example : Allowed (⟨0,2,7,1⟩ : Tile) := by
+  rw [← first_transition]
+  exact tile_allowed 1
+
+example : ∃ i : Fin 942, tile i = ⟨3,436,4,4⟩ :=
+  (allowed_iff_tile _).mp Allowed.initHead
+
+example : Allowed (⟨204,0,0,432⟩ : Tile) := by
+  have h : 215 ∈ targets true := by decide +kernel
+  have hr : rail true 215 = 204 := by decide +kernel
+  have hh := Allowed.receive true 215 h (0 : Fin 2)
+  change Allowed (⟨rail true 215,0,0,432⟩ : Tile) at hh
+  simpa only [hr] using hh
+
+example {p q : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ targets true) (hq : q ∈ targets true)
+    (he : rail true p = rail true q) : p = q :=
+  rail_injective_on true hp hq he
+
+example {p q : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ targets false) (hq : q ∈ targets true) :
+    rail false p ≠ rail true q := directional_rails_disjoint hp hq
+
+example (i : Fin 942) : 5 < 255 - (tile i).west ∧ 5 < 255 - (tile i).east := by
+  obtain ⟨hw,he⟩ := tile_horizontal_bound i
+  omega

+#print axioms action_target_mem

+#print axioms mem_targets_iff_decoded
+#print axioms rail_strict_mono

+#print axioms right_rail_range
+#print axioms left_rail_range
+#print axioms directional_rails_disjoint

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Language
+import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
+
+/-!
+# Pulling an actual marked cyclic Wang word back to the plane
+
+The cyclic matching convention is East(i) = West(i-1) and
+South(i) = North(i-s). The integer address -x-s*t therefore places the
+east neighbor at (x+1,t) and the next time row at (x,t+1). The shift is
+arbitrary; there is no coprimality, rectangular shape, unique Start,
+occupation, machine-run, or halting premise.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Periodic
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+
+/-- An actual indexed word on a nonempty cyclic group, with Start fixed at
+zero and exactly the two literal color-matching conditions. -/
+structure MarkedWord (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (s : ℤ) (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) : Prop where
+  start_at_zero : a 0 = 0
+  horizontal : ∀ i, (tile (a i)).east = (tile (a (i - 1))).west
+  temporal : ∀ i, (tile (a i)).south = (tile (a (i - (s : ZMod N)))).north
+
+/-- The signed pullback address; subtraction takes place before the cast. -/
+def address (N : ℕ) (s x t : ℤ) : ZMod N := ((-x - s*t : ℤ) : ZMod N)
+
+/-- Every plane entry remains an index in the exact 942-tile table. -/
+def plane (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (x t : ℤ) : Tile :=
+  tile (a (address N s x t))
+
+@[simp] theorem address_origin (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) : address N s 0 0 = 0 := by
+  simp [address]
+
+theorem address_east (N : ℕ) (s x t : ℤ) :
+    address N s (x+1) t = address N s x t - 1 := by
+  unfold address
+  push_cast
+  ring
+
+theorem address_next_row (N : ℕ) (s x t : ℤ) :
+    address N s x (t+1) = address N s x t - (s : ZMod N) := by
+  unfold address
+  push_cast
+  ring
+
+/-- The horizontal period is the complete cyclic modulus, with no claim
+that it is a least period. -/
+theorem address_horizontal_period (N : ℕ) (s x t : ℤ) :
+    address N s (x + (N : ℤ)) t = address N s x t := by
+  simp [address]
+
+/-- A vertical shift by N also leaves the address unchanged for every s. -/
+theorem address_vertical_period (N : ℕ) (s x t : ℤ) :
+    address N s x (t + (N : ℤ)) = address N s x t := by
+  simp [address]
+
+/-- The additional helical period follows from the same signed address. -/
+theorem address_helical_period (N : ℕ) (s x t : ℤ) :
+    address N s (x-s) (t+1) = address N s x t := by
+  unfold address
+  push_cast
+  ring
+
+theorem plane_allowed (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (x t : ℤ) :
+    Allowed (plane N s a x t) := tile_allowed _
+
+theorem plane_horizontal_period (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (x t : ℤ) :
+    plane N s a (x + (N : ℤ)) t = plane N s a x t := by
+  unfold plane
+  rw [address_horizontal_period]
+
+theorem plane_vertical_period (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (x t : ℤ) :
+    plane N s a x (t + (N : ℤ)) = plane N s a x t := by
+  unfold plane
+  rw [address_vertical_period]
+
+theorem plane_helical_period (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (x t : ℤ) :
+    plane N s a (x-s) (t+1) = plane N s a x t := by
+  unfold plane
+  rw [address_helical_period]
+
+/-- The two rectangular period vectors are (N,0) and (0,N), without any
+constraint on the temporal shift. -/
+theorem plane_periodic (N : ℕ) (s : ℤ) (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) :
+    (∀ t, Function.Periodic (fun x => plane N s a x t) (N : ℤ)) ∧
+    (∀ x, Function.Periodic (fun t => plane N s a x t) (N : ℤ)) := by
+  exact ⟨fun t x => plane_horizontal_period N s a x t,
+    fun x t => plane_vertical_period N s a x t⟩
+
+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {s : ℤ} {a : ZMod N → Fin 942}
+
+/-- Actual color orientation: the west edge at x+1 is the east edge at x. -/
+theorem plane_east_matching (h : MarkedWord N s a) (x t : ℤ) :
+    (plane N s a (x+1) t).west = (plane N s a x t).east := by
+  unfold plane
+  rw [address_east]
+  exact (h.horizontal (address N s x t)).symm
+
+/-- Actual time orientation: the north edge in row t+1 is the south edge in t. -/
+theorem plane_time_matching (h : MarkedWord N s a) (x t : ℤ) :
+    (plane N s a x (t+1)).north = (plane N s a x t).south := by
+  unfold plane
+  rw [address_next_row]
+  exact (h.temporal (address N s x t)).symm
+
+theorem plane_start (h : MarkedWord N s a) : plane N s a 0 0 = start := by
+  unfold plane
+  rw [address_origin, h.start_at_zero]
+  exact start_zero
+
+/-- The whole geometric endpoint: actual tiles, a marked origin, correct
+matching, and two positive-length periods. No machine semantics is included. -/
+theorem marked_periodic_plane (h : MarkedWord N s a) :
+    (∀ x t, Allowed (plane N s a x t)) ∧
+    plane N s a 0 0 = start ∧
+    (∀ x t, (plane N s a (x+1) t).west = (plane N s a x t).east) ∧
+    (∀ x t, (plane N s a x (t+1)).north = (plane N s a x t).south) ∧
+    0 < (N : ℤ) ∧
+    (∀ t, Function.Periodic (fun x => plane N s a x t) (N : ℤ)) ∧
+    (∀ x, Function.Periodic (fun t => plane N s a x t) (N : ℤ)) := by
+  exact ⟨plane_allowed N s a, plane_start h, plane_east_matching h,
+    plane_time_matching h, by exact_mod_cast NeZero.pos N, plane_periodic N s a⟩
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Periodic

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Periodic
+
+/-! Checks of the signed cyclic address and the exact matching orientation.
+No marked word is postulated to exist, and no machine semantics is assumed. -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942PeriodicChecks
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942Periodic
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+
+-- Moving east subtracts one, and advancing a row subtracts s.
+example : address 7 3 2 4 = 0 ∧ address 7 3 3 4 = 6 ∧
+    address 7 3 2 5 = 4 := by decide +kernel
+
+-- The opposite sign is genuinely different, not an interchangeable convention.
+example : address 7 3 3 4 ≠ address 7 3 2 4 + 1 ∧
+    address 7 3 2 5 ≠ address 7 3 2 4 + 3 := by decide +kernel
+
+example : address 7 (-3) 2 4 = 3 ∧ address 7 3 (-2) (-4) = 0 := by decide +kernel
+
+-- Neither coprimality, shift divisibility, nor a reduced shift is needed.
+example (a : ZMod 6 → Fin 942) (x t : ℤ) :
+    plane 6 14 a (x+6) t = plane 6 14 a x t ∧
+    plane 6 14 a x (t+6) = plane 6 14 a x t :=
+  ⟨plane_horizontal_period 6 14 a x t, plane_vertical_period 6 14 a x t⟩
+
+example (a : ZMod 6 → Fin 942) (x t : ℤ) :
+    plane 6 (-14) a (x+14) (t+1) = plane 6 (-14) a x t := by
+  simpa using plane_helical_period 6 (-14) a x t
+
+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {s : ℤ} {a : ZMod N → Fin 942}
+
+-- These are all fields of the input structure; no uniqueness or run field exists.
+example (h0 : a 0 = 0)
+    (hH : ∀ i, (tile (a i)).east = (tile (a (i-1))).west)
+    (hT : ∀ i, (tile (a i)).south = (tile (a (i-(s : ZMod N)))).north) :
+    MarkedWord N s a := ⟨h0,hH,hT⟩
+
+example (h : MarkedWord N s a) : plane N s a 0 0 = ⟨2,435,3,1⟩ := plane_start h
+
+example (h : MarkedWord N s a) (x t : ℤ) :
+    (plane N s a (x+1) t).west = (plane N s a x t).east ∧
+    (plane N s a x (t+1)).north = (plane N s a x t).south :=
+  ⟨plane_east_matching h x t, plane_time_matching h x t⟩
+
+example (h : MarkedWord N s a) :
+    (∀ x t, Allowed (plane N s a x t)) ∧ plane N s a 0 0 = start :=
+  ⟨plane_allowed N s a, plane_start h⟩
+
+example (s₀ : ℕ) (h : MarkedWord N (s₀ : ℤ) a) (x t : ℤ) :
+    (plane N (s₀ : ℤ) a x (t+1)).north = (plane N (s₀ : ℤ) a x t).south :=
+  plane_time_matching h x t
+
+#print axioms address_east
+#print axioms address_next_row
+#print axioms address_horizontal_period
+#print axioms address_vertical_period
+#print axioms plane_allowed
+#print axioms plane_helical_period
+#print axioms plane_periodic
+#print axioms plane_east_matching
+#print axioms plane_time_matching
+#print axioms plane_start
+#print axioms marked_periodic_plane
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942PeriodicChecks

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Boundary
+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942Periodic
+
+/-!
+# Seam columns are invariant in integer time
+
+The generic result needs only allowed tiles and the actual vertical
+matching convention. Horizontal matching and periodicity are unnecessary.
+The marked-word specialization preserves the exact plane address and
+shows that the column containing the origin Start is never a seam.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942SeamColumns
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942Boundary WangTiles942Periodic
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+
+/-- North color 437 detects the seam status of this position. -/
+def SeamAt (T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile) (x t : ℤ) : Prop := (T x t).north = 437
+
+section Generic
+
+variable {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile}
+variable (hAllowed : ∀ x t, Allowed (T x t))
+variable (hTime : ∀ x t, (T x (t+1)).north = (T x t).south)
+
+include hAllowed in
+theorem seam_at_iff_south (x t : ℤ) : SeamAt T x t ↔ (T x t).south = 437 :=
+  north_437_iff_south_437 (hAllowed x t)
+
+include hAllowed hTime
+
+/-- A time step cannot introduce or remove a seam in an allowed column. -/
+theorem seam_successor_iff (x t : ℤ) : SeamAt T x (t+1) ↔ SeamAt T x t := by
+  unfold SeamAt
+  rw [hTime x t]
+  exact (north_437_iff_south_437 (hAllowed x t)).symm
+
+/-- Integer induction covers both future and past; there is no period premise. -/
+theorem seam_iff_zero (x t : ℤ) : SeamAt T x t ↔ SeamAt T x 0 := by
+  induction t using Int.induction_on with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ n ih => exact (seam_successor_iff hAllowed hTime x (n : ℤ)).trans ih
+  | pred n ih =>
+      have hs := seam_successor_iff hAllowed hTime x (-(n : ℤ)-1)
+      simp only [sub_add_cancel] at hs
+      exact hs.symm.trans ih
+
+theorem seam_iff_time (x t u : ℤ) : SeamAt T x t ↔ SeamAt T x u :=
+  (seam_iff_zero hAllowed hTime x t).trans (seam_iff_zero hAllowed hTime x u).symm
+
+/-- A seam at one time forces one of the nine actual seam tuples at every
+integer time. The two finite horizontal parameters may vary with time. -/
+theorem column_seam_tuples (x t₀ : ℤ) (hs : SeamAt T x t₀) :
+    ∀ t : ℤ, ∃ a b : Fin 3, T x t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩ := by
+  intro t
+  apply (north_437_iff_seam (hAllowed x t)).mp
+  exact (seam_iff_time hAllowed hTime x t t₀).mpr hs
+
+theorem column_seam_tuples_of_exists (x : ℤ) (hs : ∃ t, SeamAt T x t) :
+    ∀ t : ℤ, ∃ a b : Fin 3, T x t = ⟨a.val^2,437,b.val,437⟩ := by
+  obtain ⟨t₀,hs⟩ := hs
+  exact column_seam_tuples hAllowed hTime x t₀ hs
+
+/-- A Start at any one position excludes a seam throughout that column;
+the other tiles in the column are not asserted to be Start. -/
+theorem start_column_not_seam (x t₀ : ℤ) (hStart : T x t₀ = start) (t : ℤ) :
+    ¬ SeamAt T x t := by
+  intro hs
+  have h₀ := (seam_iff_time hAllowed hTime x t t₀).mp hs
+  norm_num [SeamAt, hStart, start] at h₀
+
+theorem start_column_vertical_ne (x t₀ : ℤ) (hStart : T x t₀ = start) (t : ℤ) :
+    (T x t).north ≠ 437 ∧ (T x t).south ≠ 437 := by
+  have hn := start_column_not_seam hAllowed hTime x t₀ hStart t
+  refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
+  intro hs
+  exact hn ((seam_at_iff_south hAllowed x t).mpr hs)
+
+end Generic
+
+section Marked
+
+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {s : ℤ} {a : ZMod N → Fin 942}
+
+/-- Specialization to the actual signed marked-word plane, with no added
+periodicity, alignment, uniqueness, or computation hypothesis. -/
+theorem marked_seam_iff_zero (h : MarkedWord N s a) (x t : ℤ) :
+    SeamAt (plane N s a) x t ↔ SeamAt (plane N s a) x 0 :=
+  seam_iff_zero (plane_allowed N s a) (plane_time_matching h) x t
+
+theorem marked_column_seam_tuples (h : MarkedWord N s a) (x t₀ : ℤ)
+    (hs : SeamAt (plane N s a) x t₀) :
+    ∀ t : ℤ, ∃ u v : Fin 3, plane N s a x t = ⟨u.val^2,437,v.val,437⟩ :=
+  column_seam_tuples (plane_allowed N s a) (plane_time_matching h) x t₀ hs
+
+theorem marked_origin_never_seam (h : MarkedWord N s a) (t : ℤ) :
+    (plane N s a 0 t).north ≠ 437 ∧ (plane N s a 0 t).south ≠ 437 :=
+  start_column_vertical_ne (plane_allowed N s a) (plane_time_matching h)
+    0 0 (plane_start h) t
+
+end Marked
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942SeamColumns

+import DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942SeamColumns
+
+/-! Checks distinguish the necessary local/time premises from unneeded
+horizontal or periodic premises, and cover negative integer times. -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942SeamColumnsChecks
+
+open WangTiles942 WangTiles942Language WangTiles942Periodic WangTiles942SeamColumns
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
+
+-- This is an allowed time-matching column family, but it is not horizontally matched.
+def constantSeam (_x _t : ℤ) : Tile := ⟨4,437,2,437⟩
+
+private theorem constant_allowed (x t : ℤ) : Allowed (constantSeam x t) :=
+  Allowed.seam (2 : Fin 3) (2 : Fin 3)
+
+private theorem constant_time (x t : ℤ) :
+    (constantSeam x (t+1)).north = (constantSeam x t).south := rfl
+
+example : ¬ (∀ x t, (constantSeam (x+1) t).west = (constantSeam x t).east) := by
+  intro h
+  have hh := h 0 0
+  norm_num [constantSeam] at hh
+
+example (x : ℤ) : SeamAt constantSeam x (-31) ↔ SeamAt constantSeam x 17 :=
+  seam_iff_time constant_allowed constant_time x (-31) 17
+
+example (x t : ℤ) : ∃ u v : Fin 3, constantSeam x t = ⟨u.val^2,437,v.val,437⟩ :=
+  column_seam_tuples constant_allowed constant_time x 0 rfl t
+
+-- Allowedness without time matching does not make a seam invariant.
+def jumpPlane (_x t : ℤ) : Tile := if t = 0 then ⟨4,437,2,437⟩ else ⟨0,0,0,0⟩
+
+private theorem jump_allowed (x t : ℤ) : Allowed (jumpPlane x t) := by
+  by_cases h : t = 0
+  · rw [jumpPlane, if_pos h]
+    exact Allowed.seam (2 : Fin 3) (2 : Fin 3)
+  · rw [jumpPlane, if_neg h]
+    exact Allowed.pass (0 : Fin 2) (0 : Fin 2)
+
+example : SeamAt jumpPlane 0 0 ∧ ¬ SeamAt jumpPlane 0 1 := by
+  norm_num [SeamAt, jumpPlane]
+
+example : ¬ (∀ x t, (jumpPlane x (t+1)).north = (jumpPlane x t).south) := by
+  intro h
+  have hh := h 0 0
+  norm_num [jumpPlane] at hh
+
+-- Conversely, time matching alone does not supply the local seam equivalence.
+def unallowedPlane (_x t : ℤ) : Tile :=
+  ⟨0, if t = 0 then 437 else 0, 0, if t+1 = 0 then 437 else 0⟩
+
+example (x t : ℤ) : (unallowedPlane x (t+1)).north = (unallowedPlane x t).south := rfl
+
+example : SeamAt unallowedPlane 0 0 ∧ ¬ SeamAt unallowedPlane 0 1 := by
+  norm_num [SeamAt, unallowedPlane]
+
+example : ¬ Allowed (unallowedPlane 0 0) := by
+  intro h
+  have he := WangTiles942Boundary.north_437_iff_south_437 h
+  norm_num [unallowedPlane] at he
+
+example {T : ℤ → ℤ → Tile} (hA : ∀ x t, Allowed (T x t))
+    (hT : ∀ x t, (T x (t+1)).north = (T x t).south)
+    (h0 : T 7 (-5) = start) (t : ℤ) : (T 7 t).north ≠ 437 ∧ (T 7 t).south ≠ 437 :=
+  start_column_vertical_ne hA hT 7 (-5) h0 t
+
+example {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {s : ℤ} {a : ZMod N → Fin 942}
+    (h : MarkedWord N s a) (t : ℤ) :
+    (plane N s a 0 t).north ≠ 437 ∧ (plane N s a 0 t).south ≠ 437 :=
+  marked_origin_never_seam h t
+
+#print axioms seam_at_iff_south
+#print axioms seam_successor_iff
+#print axioms seam_iff_zero
+#print axioms seam_iff_time
+#print axioms column_seam_tuples
+#print axioms column_seam_tuples_of_exists
+#print axioms start_column_not_seam
+#print axioms start_column_vertical_ne
+#print axioms marked_seam_iff_zero
+#print axioms marked_column_seam_tuples
+#print axioms marked_origin_never_seam
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.WangTiles942SeamColumnsChecks

+# Shorter Lean proofs for DiophantineConsistency
+
+Source review prepared 26 October 2026 for Vladimir Reshetnikov.
+
+- ProveIt commit: `60e9c5d620c6c387d932876cfa2d9376f64ea56c`
+- Lean: `leanprover/lean4:v4.32.0`
+- mathlib: `81a5d257c8e410db227a6665ed08f64fea08e997`
+
+Start with **report.pdf**. The complete LaTeX source is **report.tex**, with its
+small included `validation-table.tex`. Build it with XeLaTeX twice; required
+fonts are Nimbus Roman, Nimbus Sans, and DejaVu Sans Mono. Standard TeX packages
+used by the source include fontspec, fvextra, hyperref, xurl and microtype.
+
+## What is included
+
+- `lean/`: independently checked demonstrations, each in a separate namespace
+  or file; `validation/validation.json` is the authoritative per-file status.
+- `proposals/`: further Lean demonstrations or candidate source modules whose
+  integration has not been checked. These are explicitly proposals.
+- `patches/`: reviewable patches against the pinned commit. Their validation
+  levels differ; read the status file before applying any patch.
+- `checked-modules/`: the four complete modified source files used in successful
+  PR-congruence and assignment-transport compilation checks.
+- `generated-candidate/`: full alternative generated circuit Steps files.
+  Static checks preserve all 1,192 public signatures and validate exponent
+  labels against literal nodes. Full Lean integration has not been performed.
+- `scripts/`: source census, non-mutating candidate generator, independent
+  static auditor, and a proof-demo replay command.
+- `data/`: per-file hashes, source census, declaration locations, candidate
+  metrics, and static audit receipts.
+- `validation/`: successful compilation logs, complete modified PR-module
+  checks, and an explicit statement of incomplete integration checks.
+- `source_notes/`: detailed family-specific source reviews.
+
+The largest generated candidate saves **1,650 physical lines** (6,567 to
+4,917), including new helpers and label data. This is a source reduction, not
+a measured runtime improvement or a completed repository refactor. The
+primitive-recursion patch saves **34 lines** and has been checked in complete
+modified files. The assignment-transport patch saves **25 lines** and its
+complete modified file also compiled. Ten standalone demonstration files passed.
+All mathematical premises and executable program values of those proof-only
+replacements are retained. Their exact standard-axiom footprint can change,
+as documented below and in the validation record.
+
+## Replay the checked examples
+
+Use an isolated checkout of ProveIt at the exact commit above with its pinned
+Lean/mathlib installation. From this unpacked directory:
+
+```sh
+python3 scripts/replay.py /path/to/ProveIt
+```
+
+With dependencies already built, add `--without-build`. The script builds
+only the local imports needed by selected demos, compiles each file separately,
+and saves logs and exit codes. It does not apply patches. The default selection
+contains only demos marked compiled in the supplied validation record. Use
+`--include-proposals` deliberately to experiment with the other demos.
+
+The axiom-marker check is an additional output check, not a complete parser of
+Lean environments. Inspect the included `#print axioms` output. Standard axiom
+footprints can differ between two valid proofs; the source notes discuss the
+recursor-congruence tradeoff and its induction-based alternative.
+
+## Static source and candidate checks
+
+```sh
+python3 scripts/inventory.py /path/to/ProveIt census-output
+python3 scripts/generate_steps_candidate.py /path/to/ProveIt candidate-output
+python3 scripts/audit_steps_candidate.py /path/to/ProveIt candidate-output static-audit.json
+git -C /path/to/ProveIt apply --check /absolute/path/to/patches/pr-congruence.patch
+```
+
+For the census, a full checkout reproduces the 165 additional archived/provenance
+Lean files outside the maintained `Lean` tree. A sparse checkout may omit those
+extra copies while reproducing the maintained-tree measurements.
+
+The generated-source patch requires a corresponding update to the upstream
+`tools/generate_split_recipe_steps59.py` template and gap wrapper before
+integration. The supplied standalone generator proposes the output; it does
+not replace the full upstream generation pipeline. Without updating that
+pipeline, upstream regeneration checks would overwrite or reject the changed
+output. Rebuild Registers/Recipe/Translation clients after adopting it.
+
+The conditional-padding patch changes the theorem API and must be applied to
+both its producer and caller together. Other proof-only patches can be reviewed
+independently. The source-only alternatives and checked demos sometimes show
+different stages of the same interface; do not import alternative declarations
+with the same names into one Lean environment.
+
+## Scope and limitations
+
+This packet proposes proof simplifications. It contains no new consistency
+decision, no new Diophantine equation, no global optimality claim, and no
+completed internal-ZFC equivalence. Selected examples and modified modules were
+checked; the entire 546-file maintained tree was not rebuilt. Static signature
+checks do not replace Lean elaboration. Runtime improvements were not measured.
+No remote repository changes were made.
+
+`MANIFEST.sha256` gives a SHA-256 hash for every packaged file other than itself.
+Repository-derived snippets and candidate files are covered by the supplied
+MIT No Attribution license. New code in this packet is offered under the same
+license.

+import Mathlib.Computability.Primrec.List
+
+/-!
+# Executable primitive recursive programs
+
+`PRCode` is the data-valued counterpart of `Nat.Primrec'`. Its five
+constructors store a finite program rather than an existence proof. Evaluation
+is computable and is certified primitive recursive. No program is selected
+from a proposition.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency
+
+/-- Primitive recursive syntax on fixed-length vectors of natural numbers. -/
+inductive PRCode : ℕ → Type
+  | zero : PRCode 0
+  | succ : PRCode 1
+  | get {n : ℕ} (index : Fin n) : PRCode n
+  | comp {m n : ℕ} (outer : PRCode n) (inner : Fin n → PRCode m) : PRCode m
+  | prec {n : ℕ} (base : PRCode n) (step : PRCode (n + 2)) : PRCode (n + 1)
+
+namespace PRCode
+
+/-- The standard primitive recursion semantics, in the same coordinate order
+as `Nat.Primrec'`: the step receives the index, previous result, parameters. -/
+def eval {n : ℕ} : PRCode n → List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ
+  | .zero, _ => 0
+  | .succ, v => v.head.succ
+  | .get i, v => v.get i
+  | .comp f g, v => f.eval (List.Vector.ofFn (fun i => (g i).eval v))
+  | .prec f g, v =>
+      v.head.rec (f.eval v.tail) (fun i acc => g.eval (i ::ᵥ acc ::ᵥ v.tail))
+
+@[simp] theorem eval_zero (v : List.Vector ℕ 0) : zero.eval v = 0 := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_succ (v : List.Vector ℕ 1) : succ.eval v = v.head.succ := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_get {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (v : List.Vector ℕ n) :
+    (get i).eval v = v.get i := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_comp {m n : ℕ} (f : PRCode n) (g : Fin n → PRCode m)
+    (v : List.Vector ℕ m) :
+    (comp f g).eval v = f.eval (List.Vector.ofFn (fun i => (g i).eval v)) := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_rec {n : ℕ} (f : PRCode n) (g : PRCode (n + 2))
+    (v : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1)) :
+    (prec f g).eval v =
+      v.head.rec (f.eval v.tail) (fun i acc => g.eval (i ::ᵥ acc ::ᵥ v.tail)) := rfl
+
+/-- Each supplied program computes a primitive recursive function. -/
+theorem primrec {n : ℕ} (c : PRCode n) : Nat.Primrec' c.eval := by
+  induction c with
+  | zero => exact Nat.Primrec'.zero
+  | succ => exact Nat.Primrec'.succ
+  | get i => exact Nat.Primrec'.get i
+  | comp f g hf hg => exact Nat.Primrec'.comp (fun i => (g i).eval) hf hg
+  | prec f g hf hg => exact Nat.Primrec'.prec hf hg
+
+/-- Constants are explicit programs at every arity. -/
+def constant (n : ℕ) : ℕ → PRCode n
+  | 0 => .comp .zero Fin.elim0
+  | k + 1 => .comp .succ (fun _ => constant n k)
+
+@[simp] theorem eval_constant (n k : ℕ) (v : List.Vector ℕ n) :
+    (constant n k).eval v = k := by
+  induction k with
+  | zero => rfl
+  | succ k ih =>
+      simpa only [constant, eval_comp, eval_succ, List.Vector.head_ofFn] using
+        (congrArg Nat.succ ih)
+
+/-- A program paired with its checked specification. In particular, an
+elaboration-time extractor can return code and a kernel-checked equality. -/
+def Realizes {n : ℕ} (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) :=
+  {c : PRCode n // ∀ v, c.eval v = f v}
+
+namespace Realizes
+
+def zero : Realizes (fun _ : List.Vector ℕ 0 => 0) := ⟨.zero, fun _ => rfl⟩
+def succ : Realizes (fun v : List.Vector ℕ 1 => v.head.succ) := ⟨.succ, fun _ => rfl⟩
+def get {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : Realizes (fun v : List.Vector ℕ n => v.get i) :=
+  ⟨.get i, fun _ => rfl⟩
+
+def comp {m n : ℕ} {f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ}
+    {g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m → ℕ} (p : Realizes f) (q : ∀ i, Realizes (g i)) :
+    Realizes (fun v => f (List.Vector.ofFn (fun i => g i v))) := by
+  refine ⟨.comp p.val (fun i => (q i).val), ?_⟩
+  intro v
+  exact (p.property _).trans
+    (congrArg (fun h => f (List.Vector.ofFn h)) (funext (fun i => (q i).property v)))
+
+def prec {n : ℕ} {f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ} {g : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) → ℕ}
+    (p : Realizes f) (q : Realizes g) :
+    Realizes (fun v : List.Vector ℕ (n + 1) =>
+      v.head.rec (f v.tail) (fun i acc => g (i ::ᵥ acc ::ᵥ v.tail))) := by
+  refine ⟨.prec p.val q.val, ?_⟩
+  intro v
+  simp only [eval, p.property, q.property]
+
+/-- Keep program data and transport its specification using a supplied proof. -/
+def ofEq {n : ℕ} {f g : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ} (p : Realizes f)
+    (h : ∀ v, f v = g v) : Realizes g :=
+  ⟨p.val, fun v => (p.property v).trans (h v)⟩
+
+end Realizes
+
+end PRCode
+
+end DiophantineConsistency

+import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
+import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Ring.Unbundled.Basic
+import Mathlib.Data.Int.Order.Basic
+import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic
+
+/-!
+# Executable syntax for finite Diophantine representations
+
+`Expr` stores arithmetic syntax, and `Rep` stores a finite witness count and
+an expression together with its correctness theorem. Both live in `Type`:
+their data are supplied directly, rather than extracted from a proposition
+using choice. The expression evaluator and all representation constructors
+are executable. `Expr.toPolynomial` supplies the ordinary mathematical
+polynomial denoted by the same syntax.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency
+
+/-- Integer arithmetic syntax with a specified type of variables. -/
+inductive Expr (σ : Type*)
+  | constant (value : ℤ)
+  | var (index : σ)
+  | add (left right : Expr σ)
+  | sub (left right : Expr σ)
+  | mul (left right : Expr σ)
+  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
+
+namespace Expr
+
+variable {σ τ : Type*}
+
+instance (n : ℕ) : OfNat (Expr σ) n := ⟨constant n⟩
+instance : Add (Expr σ) := ⟨add⟩
+instance : Sub (Expr σ) := ⟨sub⟩
+instance : Mul (Expr σ) := ⟨mul⟩
+instance : Neg (Expr σ) := ⟨fun e => sub (constant 0) e⟩
+
+/-- Evaluate syntax using integer arithmetic. -/
+def eval (v : σ → ℤ) : Expr σ → ℤ
+  | .constant a => a
+  | .var i => v i
+  | .add p q => p.eval v + q.eval v
+  | .sub p q => p.eval v - q.eval v
+  | .mul p q => p.eval v * q.eval v
+
+@[simp] theorem eval_constant (v : σ → ℤ) (a : ℤ) : (constant a).eval v = a := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_var (v : σ → ℤ) (i : σ) : (var i).eval v = v i := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_add (v : σ → ℤ) (p q : Expr σ) :
+    (p + q).eval v = p.eval v + q.eval v := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_sub (v : σ → ℤ) (p q : Expr σ) :
+    (p - q).eval v = p.eval v - q.eval v := rfl
+@[simp] theorem eval_mul (v : σ → ℤ) (p q : Expr σ) :
+    (p * q).eval v = p.eval v * q.eval v := rfl
+
+/-- A fixed natural power is expanded by an executable syntax constructor. -/
+def pow (e : Expr σ) : ℕ → Expr σ
+  | 0 => .constant 1
+  | n + 1 => .mul (e.pow n) e
+
+instance : Pow (Expr σ) ℕ := ⟨pow⟩
+
+@[simp] theorem eval_pow (e : Expr σ) (n : ℕ) (v : σ → ℤ) :
+    (e ^ n).eval v = e.eval v ^ n := by
+  change (e.pow n).eval v = _
+  induction n <;> simp_all [pow, eval, pow_succ]
+
+/-- Rename variables without inspecting their values. -/
+def rename (f : σ → τ) : Expr σ → Expr τ
+  | .constant a => .constant a
+  | .var i => .var (f i)
+  | .add p q => .add (p.rename f) (q.rename f)
+  | .sub p q => .sub (p.rename f) (q.rename f)
+  | .mul p q => .mul (p.rename f) (q.rename f)
+
+@[simp] theorem eval_rename (e : Expr σ) (f : σ → τ) (v : τ → ℤ) :
+    (e.rename f).eval v = e.eval (v ∘ f) := by
+  induction e <;> simp_all [rename, eval]
+
+/-- Substitute arithmetic expressions for variables. -/
+def subst (f : σ → Expr τ) : Expr σ → Expr τ
+  | .constant a => .constant a
+  | .var i => f i
+  | .add p q => .add (p.subst f) (q.subst f)
+  | .sub p q => .sub (p.subst f) (q.subst f)
+  | .mul p q => .mul (p.subst f) (q.subst f)
+
+@[simp] theorem eval_subst (e : Expr σ) (f : σ → Expr τ) (v : τ → ℤ) :
+    (e.subst f).eval v = e.eval (fun i => (f i).eval v) := by
+  induction e <;> simp_all [subst, eval]
+
+/-- Interpret the stored syntax as an ordinary integer polynomial.
+Only this algebraic interpretation uses Mathlib's noncomputable polynomial
+operations; the syntax, its evaluator, and its constructors remain executable. -/
+noncomputable def toPolynomial : Expr σ → MvPolynomial σ ℤ
+  | .constant a => MvPolynomial.C a
+  | .var i => MvPolynomial.X i
+  | .add p q => p.toPolynomial + q.toPolynomial
+  | .sub p q => p.toPolynomial - q.toPolynomial
+  | .mul p q => p.toPolynomial * q.toPolynomial
+
+@[simp] theorem eval_toPolynomial (e : Expr σ) (v : σ → ℤ) :
+    MvPolynomial.eval v e.toPolynomial = e.eval v := by
+  induction e <;> simp_all [toPolynomial, eval]
+
+end Expr
+
+/-- Integer assignments obtained from natural input and witness coordinates. -/
+def natAssignment {σ τ : Type*} (v : σ → ℕ) (w : τ → ℕ) : σ ⊕ τ → ℤ :=
+  Sum.elim (fun i => (v i : ℤ)) (fun i => (w i : ℤ))
+
+@[simp] theorem natAssignment_inl {σ τ : Type*} (v : σ → ℕ) (w : τ → ℕ) (i : σ) :
+    natAssignment v w (.inl i) = v i := rfl
+@[simp] theorem natAssignment_inr {σ τ : Type*} (v : σ → ℕ) (w : τ → ℕ) (i : τ) :
+    natAssignment v w (.inr i) = w i := rfl
+
+/-- Renaming inputs and witnesses commutes with the natural assignment. -/
+theorem natAssignment_comp_map {σ σ' τ τ' : Type*}
+    (v : σ' → ℕ) (w : τ' → ℕ) (f : σ → σ') (g : τ → τ') :
+    natAssignment v w ∘ Sum.map f g = natAssignment (v ∘ f) (w ∘ g) := by
+  funext i
+  cases i <;> rfl
+
+/-- A representation is data: a finite witness count and an explicit expression.
+The theorem field certifies the expression supplied by the constructor. -/
+structure Rep (σ : Type*) (P : (σ → ℕ) → Prop) where
+  witnessCount : ℕ
+  expression : Expr (σ ⊕ Fin witnessCount)
+  correct : ∀ v, P v ↔ ∃ w : Fin witnessCount → ℕ,
+    expression.eval (natAssignment v w) = 0
+
+namespace Rep
+
+variable {σ τ : Type*} {P Q : (σ → ℕ) → Prop}
+
+/-- Change the predicate while preserving all representation data. -/
+def ofIff (r : Rep σ P) (h : ∀ v, P v ↔ Q v) : Rep σ Q where
+  witnessCount := r.witnessCount
+  expression := r.expression
+  correct v := (h v).symm.trans (r.correct v)
+
+/-- The supplied expression also represents the predicate as an ordinary
+multivariate polynomial with integer coefficients. -/
+theorem correct_toPolynomial (r : Rep σ P) (v : σ → ℕ) :
+    P v ↔ ∃ w : Fin r.witnessCount → ℕ,
+      MvPolynomial.eval (natAssignment v w) r.expression.toPolynomial = 0 := by
+  simpa only [Expr.eval_toPolynomial] using r.correct v

+  witnessCount := 0
+  expression := (p - q).rename Sum.inl
+  correct v := by
+    simp only [Expr.eval_rename, Expr.eval_sub]
+    constructor
+    · intro h
+      exact ⟨Fin.elim0, sub_eq_zero.mpr h⟩
+    · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
+      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hw

+  witnessCount := r.witnessCount
+  expression := r.expression.rename (Sum.map f id)

+    simpa only [Expr.eval_rename, natAssignment_comp_map, Function.comp_id] using

+  let left := r.expression.rename (Sum.map id (Fin.castAdd s.witnessCount))
+  let right := s.expression.rename (Sum.map id (Fin.natAdd r.witnessCount))
+  refine ⟨r.witnessCount + s.witnessCount, left * left + right * right, ?_⟩
+  intro v
+  simp only [left, right, Expr.eval_add, Expr.eval_mul, Expr.eval_rename,
+    natAssignment_comp_map, Function.comp_id, mul_self_add_mul_self_eq_zero]
+  rw [r.correct, s.correct]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
+    refine ⟨Fin.addCases a b, ?_, ?_⟩
+    · simpa [Function.comp_def] using ha
+    · simpa [Function.comp_def] using hb
+  · rintro ⟨w, ha, hb⟩
+    exact ⟨⟨w ∘ Fin.castAdd s.witnessCount, ha⟩,
+      ⟨w ∘ Fin.natAdd r.witnessCount, hb⟩⟩
+
+/-- Disjunction multiplies residuals and keeps independent witness blocks.
+The unused branch may take all its natural witnesses to be zero. -/
+def disjunction (r : Rep σ P) (s : Rep σ Q) : Rep σ (fun v => P v ∨ Q v) := by
+  let left := r.expression.rename (Sum.map id (Fin.castAdd s.witnessCount))
+  let right := s.expression.rename (Sum.map id (Fin.natAdd r.witnessCount))
+  refine ⟨r.witnessCount + s.witnessCount, left * right, ?_⟩
+  intro v
+  simp only [left, right, Expr.eval_mul, Expr.eval_rename,
+    natAssignment_comp_map, Function.comp_id, mul_eq_zero]
+  rw [r.correct, s.correct]
+  constructor
+  · rintro (⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨b, hb⟩)
+    · refine ⟨Fin.addCases a (fun _ => 0), Or.inl ?_⟩
+      simpa [Function.comp_def] using ha
+    · refine ⟨Fin.addCases (fun _ => 0) b, Or.inr ?_⟩
+      simpa [Function.comp_def] using hb
+  · rintro ⟨w, ha | hb⟩
+    · exact Or.inl ⟨w ∘ Fin.castAdd s.witnessCount, ha⟩
+    · exact Or.inr ⟨w ∘ Fin.natAdd r.witnessCount, hb⟩
+
+/-- Move a finite block of input coordinates into the existential witnesses. -/
+def existsBlock {k : ℕ} {P : (σ ⊕ Fin k → ℕ) → Prop}
+    (r : Rep (σ ⊕ Fin k) P) : Rep σ (fun v => ∃ a : Fin k → ℕ, P (Sum.elim v a)) := by
+  let index : (σ ⊕ Fin k) ⊕ Fin r.witnessCount → σ ⊕ Fin (k + r.witnessCount)
+    | .inl (.inl i) => .inl i
+    | .inl (.inr i) => .inr (Fin.castAdd r.witnessCount i)
+    | .inr i => .inr (Fin.natAdd k i)
+  refine ⟨k + r.witnessCount, r.expression.rename index, ?_⟩
+  intro v
+  have heval (w : Fin (k + r.witnessCount) → ℕ) :
+      (r.expression.rename index).eval (natAssignment v w) =
+        r.expression.eval (natAssignment (Sum.elim v (w ∘ Fin.castAdd r.witnessCount))
+          (w ∘ Fin.natAdd k)) := by
+    rw [Expr.eval_rename]
+    apply congrArg r.expression.eval
+    funext i
+    rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> rfl
+  simp only [heval]
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
+    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (r.correct _).mp ha
+    exact ⟨Fin.addCases a b, by simpa [Function.comp_def] using hb⟩
+  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
+    exact ⟨w ∘ Fin.castAdd r.witnessCount, (r.correct _).mpr ⟨w ∘ Fin.natAdd k, hw⟩⟩
+
+end Rep
+
+end DiophantineConsistency

+import Mathlib.Computability.Primrec.Basic
+
+/-!
+# Scalar primitive recursive programs
+
+This data-valued syntax mirrors the seven constructors of `Nat.Primrec`.
+Keeping pairing and its inverse projections as primitive program operations
+avoids expanding all encoding proofs into vector primitive recursion.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency
+
+inductive ScalarPRCode
+  | zero
+  | succ
+  | left
+  | right
+  | pair (first second : ScalarPRCode)
+  | comp (outer inner : ScalarPRCode)
+  | prec (base step : ScalarPRCode)
+  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
+
+namespace ScalarPRCode
+
+def eval : ScalarPRCode → ℕ → ℕ
+  | .zero, _ => 0
+  | .succ, n => n.succ
+  | .left, n => n.unpair.1
+  | .right, n => n.unpair.2
+  | .pair f g, n => Nat.pair (f.eval n) (g.eval n)
+  | .comp f g, n => f.eval (g.eval n)
+  | .prec f g, n =>
+      n.unpair.2.rec (f.eval n.unpair.1)
+        (fun i acc => g.eval (Nat.pair n.unpair.1 (Nat.pair i acc)))
+
+theorem primrec (c : ScalarPRCode) : Nat.Primrec c.eval := by
+  induction c with
+  | zero => exact Nat.Primrec.zero
+  | succ => exact Nat.Primrec.succ
+  | left => exact Nat.Primrec.left
+  | right => exact Nat.Primrec.right
+  | pair f g hf hg => exact hf.pair hg
+  | comp f g hf hg => exact hf.comp hg
+  | prec f g hf hg => exact hf.prec hg
+
+/-- A supplied scalar program with a checked specification. -/
+def Realizes (f : ℕ → ℕ) := {c : ScalarPRCode // ∀ n, c.eval n = f n}
+
+namespace Realizes
+
+def zero : Realizes (fun _ => 0) := ⟨.zero, fun _ => rfl⟩
+def succ : Realizes Nat.succ := ⟨.succ, fun _ => rfl⟩
+def left : Realizes (fun n => n.unpair.1) := ⟨.left, fun _ => rfl⟩
+def right : Realizes (fun n => n.unpair.2) := ⟨.right, fun _ => rfl⟩
+
+def pair {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (p : Realizes f) (q : Realizes g) :
+    Realizes (fun n => Nat.pair (f n) (g n)) :=
+  ⟨.pair p.val q.val, fun n => congrArg₂ Nat.pair (p.property n) (q.property n)⟩
+
+def comp {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (p : Realizes f) (q : Realizes g) :
+    Realizes (fun n => f (g n)) :=
+  ⟨.comp p.val q.val, fun n => (p.property _).trans (congrArg f (q.property n))⟩
+
+def prec {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (p : Realizes f) (q : Realizes g) :
+    Realizes (Nat.unpaired (fun z n =>
+      n.rec (f z) (fun i acc => g (Nat.pair z (Nat.pair i acc))))) := by
+  refine ⟨.prec p.val q.val, ?_⟩
+  intro packed
+  simp only [eval, Nat.unpaired, p.property, q.property]
+
+def ofEq {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (p : Realizes f) (h : ∀ n, f n = g n) : Realizes g :=
+  ⟨p.val, fun n => (p.property n).trans (h n)⟩
+
+end Realizes
+end ScalarPRCode
+end DiophantineConsistency

+import DiophantineConsistency.ScalarPRCode
+import Mathlib.Tactic.SplitIfs
+import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
+
+/-!
+# Certified simplification of supplied primitive-recursive programs
+
+Simplifying the program before the Diophantine compiler can remove complete
+recursion traces. Every rule preserves evaluation at every natural input.
+No rule runs a search or depends on the consistency predicate.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.ScalarPRCode
+
+/-- Number of instruction nodes in the supplied finite program tree. -/
+def nodeCount : ScalarPRCode → ℕ
+  | .zero | .succ | .left | .right => 1
+  | .pair f g | .comp f g | .prec f g => 1 + f.nodeCount + g.nodeCount
+
+/-- Composition rules that remove constant, projection, and identity plumbing. -/
+def smartComp (f g : ScalarPRCode) : ScalarPRCode :=
+  match f, g with
+  | .zero, _ => .zero
+  | .left, .pair a _ => a
+  | .right, .pair _ b => b
+  | .pair .left .right, _ => g
+  | _, .pair .left .right => f
+  | _, _ => .comp f g
+
+theorem eval_smartComp (f g : ScalarPRCode) (n : ℕ) :
+    (smartComp f g).eval n = f.eval (g.eval n) := by
+  unfold smartComp
+  split <;> simp [eval, Nat.pair_unpair]
+
+theorem nodeCount_smartComp_le (f g : ScalarPRCode) :
+    (smartComp f g).nodeCount ≤ 1 + f.nodeCount + g.nodeCount := by
+  unfold smartComp
+  split <;> simp_all [nodeCount] <;> omega
+
+/-- Eliminate a redundant pair of inverse projections of the same program. -/
+def smartPair (f g : ScalarPRCode) : ScalarPRCode :=
+  match f, g with
+  | .zero, .zero => .zero
+  | .comp .left a, .comp .right b => if a = b then a else .pair f g
+  | _, _ => .pair f g
+
+theorem eval_smartPair (f g : ScalarPRCode) (n : ℕ) :
+    (smartPair f g).eval n = Nat.pair (f.eval n) (g.eval n) := by
+  unfold smartPair
+  split
+  · rfl
+  · split_ifs with h
+    · subst h
+      simp [eval, Nat.pair_unpair]
+    · rfl
+  · rfl
+
+theorem nodeCount_smartPair_le (f g : ScalarPRCode) :
+    (smartPair f g).nodeCount ≤ 1 + f.nodeCount + g.nodeCount := by
+  unfold smartPair
+  split <;> simp_all [nodeCount]
+  split_ifs <;> simp_all [nodeCount]
+  omega
+
+private theorem rec_previous (f : ℕ → ℕ) (z k : ℕ) :
+    Nat.rec (f z) (fun _ acc => acc) k = f z := by
+  induction k <;> simp_all
+
+private theorem rec_counter (k : ℕ) :
+    Nat.rec 0 (fun _ acc => acc + 1) k = k := by
+  induction k <;> simp_all
+
+private theorem rec_zero (k : ℕ) : Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ) 0 (fun _ _ => 0) k = 0 := by
+  induction k <;> simp_all
+
+/-- Remove constant-zero, unchanged-accumulator, and pure-counter recursions. -/
+def smartPrec (f g : ScalarPRCode) : ScalarPRCode :=
+  match f, g with
+  | .zero, .zero => .zero
+  | _, .comp .right .right => smartComp f .left
+  | .zero, .comp .succ (.comp .right .right) => .right
+  | _, _ => .prec f g
+
+theorem eval_smartPrec (f g : ScalarPRCode) (n : ℕ) :
+    (smartPrec f g).eval n = (ScalarPRCode.prec f g).eval n := by
+  unfold smartPrec
+  split
+  · simpa only [eval] using (rec_zero n.unpair.2).symm
+  · simp only [eval_smartComp, eval, Nat.unpair_pair]
+    exact (rec_previous _ _ _).symm
+  · simp only [eval, Nat.unpair_pair]
+    exact (rec_counter _).symm
+  · rfl
+
+theorem nodeCount_smartPrec_le (f g : ScalarPRCode) :
+    (smartPrec f g).nodeCount ≤ 1 + f.nodeCount + g.nodeCount := by
+  unfold smartPrec
+  split
+  · simp [nodeCount]
+  · exact (nodeCount_smartComp_le _ _).trans (by simp [nodeCount])
+  · simp [nodeCount]
+  · rfl
+
+/-- Simplify every subprogram, preserving executable program data. -/
+def optimize : ScalarPRCode → ScalarPRCode
+  | .zero => .zero
+  | .succ => .succ
+  | .left => .left
+  | .right => .right
+  | .pair f g => smartPair f.optimize g.optimize
+  | .comp f g => smartComp f.optimize g.optimize
+  | .prec f g => smartPrec f.optimize g.optimize
+
+theorem eval_optimize (c : ScalarPRCode) (n : ℕ) : c.optimize.eval n = c.eval n := by
+  induction c generalizing n with
+  | zero | succ | left | right => rfl
+  | pair f g hf hg => simp only [optimize, eval_smartPair, eval, hf, hg]
+  | comp f g hf hg => simp only [optimize, eval_smartComp, eval, hf, hg]
+  | prec f g hf hg =>
+      simp only [optimize, eval_smartPrec, eval, hf, hg]
+
+/-- The optimizer never increases the finite program tree. -/
+theorem nodeCount_optimize_le (c : ScalarPRCode) : c.optimize.nodeCount ≤ c.nodeCount := by
+  induction c with
+  | zero | succ | left | right => rfl
+  | pair f g hf hg =>
+      exact (nodeCount_smartPair_le _ _).trans (by simp only [nodeCount]; omega)
+  | comp f g hf hg =>
+      exact (nodeCount_smartComp_le _ _).trans (by simp only [nodeCount]; omega)
+  | prec f g hf hg =>
+      exact (nodeCount_smartPrec_le _ _).trans (by simp only [nodeCount]; omega)
+
+namespace Realizes
+
+/-- Simplify a supplied program while retaining its original specification. -/
+def optimize {f : ℕ → ℕ} (p : Realizes f) : Realizes f :=
+  ⟨p.val.optimize, fun n => (eval_optimize p.val n).trans (p.property n)⟩
+
+end Realizes
+end DiophantineConsistency.ScalarPRCode

+import DiophantineConsistency.ArithmeticDAGDegree
+
+/-!
+Standalone refactoring prototypes for ProveIt commit
+60e9c5d620c6c387d932876cfa2d9376f64ea56c.
+These use a separate namespace and do not replace upstream declarations.
+See validation.json for compilation status.
+-/
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CircuitInvariantReview
+open ArithmeticDAG
+
+variable {inputs fixed : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
+
+/-- One topological induction for properties preserved by each local node. -/
+theorem run_invariant (p : Fin fixed → R) (x : Fin inputs → R)
+    (nodes : List (Node inputs fixed)) (htop : Topological nodes)
+    (P : ℕ → R → Prop)
+    (hstep : ∀ i < nodes.length, ∀ values : ℕ → R,
+      (∀ j ∈ (nodes.getD i (.literal 0)).dependencies, P j (values j)) →
+      P i ((nodes.getD i (.literal 0)).evalAt p x values)) :
+    ∀ i < nodes.length, P i ((run p x nodes []).getD i 0) := by
+  intro i
+  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
+  | h i ih =>
+    intro hi
+    rw [run_node_equation p x nodes htop i hi]
+    apply hstep i hi
+    intro j hj
+    exact ih j (htop ⟨i, hi⟩ j hj) ((htop ⟨i, hi⟩ j hj).trans hi)
+
+/-- Same statement as the upstream node-equation uniqueness theorem. -/
+theorem run_eq_of_node_equations (p : Fin fixed → R) (x : Fin inputs → R)
+    (nodes : List (Node inputs fixed)) (htop : Topological nodes) (v : ℕ → R)
+    (hv : ∀ i < nodes.length, v i = (nodes.getD i (.literal 0)).evalAt p x v) :
+    ∀ i < nodes.length, (run p x nodes []).getD i 0 = v i := by
+  apply run_invariant p x nodes htop (fun i z => z = v i)
+  intro i hi values hprev
+  exact (Node.evalAt_congr p x values v _ hprev).trans (hv i hi).symm
+
+/-- Same statement as the upstream upper bound for circuit degree. -/
+theorem value_degree_le {σ : Type*} (p : Fin fixed → ℤ)
+    (v : Fin inputs → MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (inputDegree : Fin inputs → ℕ)
+    (hv : ∀ k, (v k).totalDegree ≤ inputDegree k)
+    (nodes : List (Node inputs fixed)) (htop : Topological nodes)
+    (label : ℕ → ℕ) (hcert : DegreeCertificate nodes inputDegree label)
+    (output : ℕ) (ho : output < nodes.length) :
+    (value nodes output (fun k => MvPolynomial.C (p k)) v).totalDegree ≤ label output := by
+  apply run_invariant (fun k => MvPolynomial.C (p k)) v nodes htop
+    (fun i q => q.totalDegree ≤ label i) _ output ho
+  intro i hi values hprev
+  exact Node.evalAt_degree_le p v inputDegree hv values label i _ (hcert ⟨i, hi⟩) hprev
+
+#print axioms run_invariant
+#print axioms run_eq_of_node_equations
+#print axioms value_degree_le
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.CircuitInvariantReview
